profile.title: Computer Science Engineering Student
profile.headline: Passionate and motivated Computer Science Engineering student with strong skills in full stack web development, IoT, AI tools, data analytics, and problem solving. Eager to learn, build real world solutions, and contribute to impactful projects.
profile.about: I am a Computer Science Engineering student currently pursuing B.Tech at Suryodaya College of Engineering & Technology. With a solid foundation in coding languages (Python, Java, C++, C), MERN full-stack development, database management, and embedded IoT systems (ESP32/ESP8266), I specialize in building practical, scalable software and civic-tech applications. Experienced in collaborative hackathons and corporate job simulations on Forage (Deloitte, Tata, Vista Equity Partners).

projects.title: Smart Construction Management System (Web)
projects.subtitle: Team Project (Hackathon)
projects.description: Developed a web platform to streamline construction monitoring and complaint management for citizens.
projects.detailedDescription: Designed and engineered an interactive web application for civic complaints and construction oversight. Implemented role-based dashboards for citizens, contractors, and government officials. Features real-time complaint submission with photo/file attachments, status tracking, automated alerts, and analytical monitoring panels.

projects.title: Portfolio Website
projects.subtitle: Personal Project
projects.description: Built a responsive portfolio website to showcase my skills, projects, and achievements.
projects.detailedDescription: A recruiter-friendly developer portfolio featuring dynamic section filtering, interactive project detail modals, dark glassmorphism styling, and a private content management dashboard to manage skills, projects, certifications, and uploaded resume files.

projects.title: Smart Home Automation System
projects.subtitle: Personal Project
projects.description: Developed an IoT based system to control home appliances using ESP32 and Blynk app.
projects.detailedDescription: Engineered an embedded hardware and cloud control system allowing remote control of home electrical appliances. Integrated ESP32 microcontroller with relay modules, sensor feedback, Wi-Fi networking, and custom Blynk smartphone dashboard interfaces.

projects.title: Task Manager Web Application
projects.subtitle: Personal Project
projects.description: Built a full stack task manager to add, update, delete and manage daily tasks.
projects.detailedDescription: Full stack task management application enabling users to organize daily responsibilities into custom categories, set deadlines, mark completion status, and filter pending vs completed tasks with backend MongoDB persistence.

projects.title: Weather Dashboard
projects.subtitle: Personal Project
projects.description: Built a weather dashboard that shows real-time weather information of any city.
projects.detailedDescription: Interactive weather tracking platform integrating OpenWeatherMap REST API to fetch live meteorological data including temperature, humidity, atmospheric pressure, wind speed, and weather condition forecasts with responsive visual UI.
